about_short_description.short_description: Salasa is a logistics company that offers commerce fulfillment services to help modern retail brands scale with speed and reliability.

product.name: FBS - Fulfilled By Salasa
product.description: A comprehensive eCommerce fulfillment service that manages storage, order processing, packing, and shipping from centralized fulfillment centers.

product.name: Domestic Shipping Services
product.description: A shipping service offering fast, flexible delivery across Saudi Arabia with multi-carrier access and real-time shipment tracking.

product.name: Hyperlocal Dark Stores
product.description: Strategically located fulfillment hubs in Riyadh enabling rapid order fulfillment and delivery within as little as two hours.

product.name: Cross-Border eCommerce Solutions
product.description: A logistics service facilitating international shipping from Saudi Arabia with customs clearance, bonded warehousing, and multi-carrier connectivity.

product.name: Operations Management System (OMS)
product.description: A cloud-based platform providing real-time visibility and control over inventory, orders, shipments, and performance metrics.

product.name: On-Demand Shipping Services
product.description: A pay-as-you-go shipping service offering same-day in-city and next-day nationwide delivery with flexible label purchasing and COD processing.
